const Bold pkg/term.Style = 5
const Gray pkg/term.Style = 4
const Green pkg/term.Style = 1
const None pkg/term.Style = 0
const Red pkg/term.Style = 3
const Yellow pkg/term.Style = 2
func Detect(io.Writer, func(string) (string, bool), bool) pkg/term.Caps
func FormatBytes(int64) string
func IsSafeRune(rune) bool
func NewTable(pkg/term.Caps, ...string) pkg/term.Table
func Paint(pkg/term.Caps, pkg/term.Style, string) string
func ProgressLine(string, int64, int64) string
func Sanitize(string) string
func StartSpinner(io.Writer, pkg/term.Caps, string, pkg/term.SpinnerOptions) pkg/term.Spinner
func Styled(pkg/term.Style, string) pkg/term.Cell
func Text(string) pkg/term.Cell
func Width(string) int
type Caps struct{Color bool; Animate bool}
type Cell struct{Text string; Style pkg/term.Style}
type Spinner interface{Stop() error; Update(int64, int64)}
type SpinnerOptions struct{Delay time.Duration; Interval time.Duration}
type Style uint8
type Table interface{Render(io.Writer) error; Row(...pkg/term.Cell)}
